content.short: All-in-one DeFi app to buy crypto with euros, swap, bridge, stake and buy bonds.
content.description: BIM Exchange combines a fiat on-ramp with a DeFi dashboard. Users pay in euros by card or bank transfer, then swap through a meta-aggregator that queries other DEX aggregators, bridge between EVM and non-EVM chains, stake, or buy bonds, all from one interface. Its yield product, BIM Yield, is deployed on Plasma.
content.meta: Buy crypto with euros, then swap, bridge, stake and buy bonds in BIM Exchange, a DEX meta-aggregator with a fiat on-ramp.
